surface_mechanism_description: ALD film deposition occurs through alternating pulses of metal-containing precursor and water. A deposition cycle is defined as a pulse of metal-containing precursor, a nitrogen purge to remove unreacted precursor, a water pulse, and a final nitrogen purge.
evidence: ALD film deposition occurs through alternating pulses of metal-containing precursor and water. A deposition cycle is defined as a pulse of metal-containing precursor, a nitrogen purge to remove unreacted precursor, a water pulse, and a final nitrogen purge. ALD films contained chlorine impurities, while MOCVD films had carbon impurities.
